verdict.rationale: Sentry docs cover alerting (sentry-docs-17), issue mute/ignore/resolve states (sentry-docs-20), and quota/rate-limit management (sentry-docs-30), which together support noise-reduction workflows for SREs. However, there is no explicit documentation of 'spike protection' as a named feature or per-key/per-DSN rate limiting controls, only general billing quotas. Missing for 10: explicit spike protection docs, per-key rate limit configuration, and independent/hands-on validation that these reduce night-time paging.
